question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word: INTEGRITY
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. Honesty .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **INTEGRITY** refers to the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles.
 
• It is synonymous with **Honesty**, which reflects uprightness and truthfulness in behavior or actions.
 
• The other options do not match the meaning of **INTEGRITY**:
 
 
• **Corruption:** Refers to dishonest or unethical conduct, opposite to integrity.
 
• **Negligence:** Refers to failure to take proper care, unrelated to moral uprightness.
 
• **Greed:** Refers to an excessive desire for wealth or power, contrary to moral principles.
 

Correct sentence: *The most appropriate synonym of **INTEGRITY** is **Honesty***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Synonyms:** Words that have a similar meaning to a given word.
 
 
• **Example:** Brave – Courageous
 
 
• **Antonyms:** Words that have an opposite meaning to a given word.
 
 
• **Example:** Honest – Dishonest
